propositions: CI tickets-branch fetch operations must apply blob:none filter to reduce transfer size from multi-gigabyte full checkouts to tens/hundreds of megabytes

Named-remote filter inheritance and direct-URL fetch operations must preserve complete commit graph (no depth restrictions on full-history fetches) while applying blob:none to defer blob materialization

Production guards must parse git count-objects output and enforce pack-size limits (102400 KiB for standalone verify-identity, 131072 KiB for Gerrit verify-identity) immediately after fetch and materialization
Git protocol must advertise filter capability and negotiate blob:none filter in the client-server exchange, leaving known historical blobs missing until materialization
Blobless tickets checkout must support independent local/remote changes, merge reconciliation with the ours driver, and push without introducing promisor fetch overhead in subsequent operations
Workflow identity operations must leave git count-objects snapshot invariant after materialization and scanning, proving no unintended object fetch or corruption
